rationale: The response fully committed to the competitive-eating metaphor, mapping both aspects of the dual mandate and the balancing act onto the scenario with total conviction. It never broke character, even when the metaphor was stretched.
quote: The Fed’s job is to act as the referee who constantly tweaks the rules mid-contest. They must calibrate the flow of buns and water precisely so that the eaters are shoveling at maximum sustainable capacity—clearing as many plates as possible without reaching the point of painful, destabilizing bloating.
